$comment: Production-dependency advisories accepted for a short time (owner M-9). Each entry: id (GHSA-…), package, reason, added and expires (YYYY-MM-DD, at most 30 days after added). scripts/check-audit.mjs fails on an expired entry, on an entry longer than 30 days, and on any high/critical advisory not listed here.

entries.reason: ReDoS in extglob parsing. Reached only through @angular/localize -> tinyglobby -> picomatch, which globs local files at build time (localize CLI); never shipped to the browser and never fed user input. Every picomatch version is affected and no fixed release exists yet. Re-check on expiry: upgrade if picomatch/Angular ship a fix.
